lines.text: Creates an image object backed by the given SF Symbol name, with optional configuration options.
- Parameters:
- systemName: name of the SF Symbol
- tintColor: an optional UIColor to tint the icon
- symbolConfiguration: an optional symbol configuration
A button that opens the current app's page in the Shortcuts app.
You can add additional targets to observe when the button is tapped.
The style to use for the button.
Creates a button with the specified style.
- Parameter style: The style to use, defaults to ``ShortcutsLinkStyle/automatic``.

A view that displays the phrase a person uses to invoke an App Shortcut.
You must call ``UISiriTip/setIntent(intent:)`` before displaying the view.
The style to use for the view.
Determines if the view should be presented to the user.
Defaults to `true` and gets set to `false` after the dismissal button is tapped.
Changing this has no affect if `allowsDismissal` is set to `false`.
This value is KVO compliant.
Indicates if the tip view should display a dismissal button
Defaults to `false`.
A view that displays the phrase for an App Shortcut.
- Parameter style: The style to use for this view, defaults to automatic.
Sets an `AppIntent` for this view. This must be called before presenting the view.
The provided `AppIntent` must be a valid App Shortcut for this view to work correctly.
